newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Newcrest to resume Telfer operations.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Newcrest to resume Telfer operations.

text.p: Newcrest Mining Ltd said on Friday that its Telfer gold mine in Western Australia should resume normal production within three to four weeks.

The company said milling and limited mining operations had resumed at Telfer following an 11 week closure of the mine's access road which severely curtailed production. The closure was due to heavy rain in the region.
"Due to the rain induced suspension of mining nad milling activities, gold production for Telfer in 1996/97 year will be below previous expectations," it said.
"Dependant upon rate at which operations can be returned to normal levels, output will be between 35,000 to 50,000 ounces below previous estimates in this financial year."
"Operating costs will be adversely impacted over the next two quarters as remedial and catch-up activities are implemented," Newcrest said.

As the wet season in northwestern Australia can extend into May, the planned recovery of Telfer production would depend on no further impact on the mine access road from extreme weather conditions, it said.
Newcrest shares were two cents lower at A$4.40 at 10.40 a.m. (2340 GMT) on Friday.
